changes.note: stereo pad: a stereo sample plays on one voice on every part, as on an even part
the part's stereo mode calls sp_mode: 0 for a stereo sample on every part
the oscillator change calls sp_claim: no part claims the next one
the voice setup calls sp_voice on an even part: mode 4, one voice

hooks.note: a stereo sample never pairs its part with the next one
the oscillator change leaves the next part alone
the voice setup takes mode 4 (one voice) on an even part too

startPhase.why: the start loads a pattern and asks each part's stereo mode, which now calls sp_mode
sp_mode runs with that call; it reads the setting word and the held keys

ram.what: the setting word of STEREO 1 PAD: FFFFFFFF or 1 on, 0 off; the BLECH menu writes it
